title: Trash Talking
content: I catch theGurney brothers trash talking while playing Rocket League:"Remember that time I destroyed you one-on-one?""If we trade who gets Foamer and who gets Boomer, it'll be devastation.""So...are you blue?""Get in, thank you very much.""If only you had an AI teammate to help you score some goals.""Oh, I thought I was going to blow you up.""So the front of the goal is solid.""Hey, the camera messed me up.""I bet you're kicking yourself for kicking it in your own goal."
